title: The Path of the Demon
lines: Fang Yuan was no hero. He had learned in five hundred years that heroes died young, praised by poets and mourned by no one who mattered. The demon path — ruthless, practical, unbound by sentiment — was the only path to true immortality.

He set out across the Southern Border, collecting the rarest Gu as a collector might gather gems. Each Gu was a weapon, a tool, a piece of a greater puzzle. The Spring Autumn Cicada that had sent him back in time. The Liquor Worm that would form his foundation. The Chainsaw Golden Centipede that would be his sword.

At the foot of Bai Gu Mountain, he encountered his first rival — Bai Ning Bing, a prodigy of the Bai clan whose talent was matched only by his arrogance. In his first life, Bai Ning Bing had been one of the countless stepping stones Fang Yuan had crushed on his climb to power.

Bai Ning Bing attacked with the Frost Moon Gu, summoning a blade of absolute cold that could freeze even spiritual energy. Fang Yuan smiled. He had fought this exact technique four hundred years ago. He knew the counter before Bai Ning Bing had finished forming the seal.
